description: We are an ambitious team of software developers and data scientists, who are eager to combine our skills to create robust and inteligent solutions.
summary:
FieldShift is a companion app for farmers.
You pick your field on a map, say what grew there last, then tell it what you care about - soil health,
safe harvest, or both, and FieldShift gives you three rotation plans side by side, with explanations. 
It also provides insights into the soil, weather conditions and plant stress.
details:
How it works

It runs a simulation. Every crop leaves something behind for the next one. The recommendation

engine plays each rotation forward, season by season, and tracks soil carbo, nitrogen, cover, water stress,

disease pressure and soil structure. It sees trends in climate/soil information, and tells you about it.

Plans don't get judged by average year, instead the worst fifth of the local weather record

proves survability.

The engine is purely deterministic, joins maths with expert rules. Every suggestions

is a plain language reason and it never lies about what it knows, or hallucinates. We're proud the solution

never fans out to an LLM.

Who it is for

Farmers who don't want to learn a whole framework or become computer science experts to plan what they plant.

One question per screen, clear buttons, plain language - Polish or English. It's a companion, a support, not a

replacement for their years of experience.

Tech stack

Flutter on frontend, .NET API in Backend and in Recommendation Engine (a separate C# lib), postgres for cache

and storage. We've also created a structured json format for crop, soil, and effects one has on the other.

The engine uses FAO-56 water balance and Saxton and Rawls soil physics.
